market.question: Will the highest temperature in New York City be between 60-61°F on May 2?

assessment.reasoning: NYC Central Park May 2 forecast high is 61°F. Question asks for 60-61°F bin (a 2-degree range). Forecast lands directly in this bin. Forecasts for highs are typically accurate within +/-2°F at 2-3 days out, so probability the actual high lands in 60-61°F given a forecast of 61°F is moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast errors push actual high to 62-65°F or 57-59°F range; 2-degree window is narrow.
